tasks.sql:
WITH rpt_quote_lines AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.quote_id, src.product_id, src.product_name, src.quantity, src.unit_price, src.amount, src.created_at FROM (
SELECT 
  ql.id,
  ql.organization_id,
  ql.quote_id,
  ql.product_id,
  COALESCE(p.name, ql.name) AS product_name,
  COALESCE(ql.quantity, 0) AS quantity,
  COALESCE(ql.unit_price, 0) AS unit_price,
  COALESCE(ql.amount, 0) AS amount,
  ql.created_at
FROM crm.quote_lines ql
LEFT JOIN inventory.products p ON p.id = ql.product_id
WHERE ql.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
),
rpt_quotes AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.deal_id, src.deal_title, src.quote_number, src.version, src.status, src.currency_code, src.subtotal, src.discount_pct, src.discount_amount, src.total, src.valid_until, src.sent_at, src.accepted_at, src.created_by_user_id, src.owner_user_id, src.owner_name, src.approval_status, src.created_at, src.updated_at FROM (
SELECT 
  q.id,
  q.organization_id,
  q.deal_id,
  d.title AS deal_title,
  q.number AS quote_number,
  q.version,
  q.status,
  COALESCE(q.currency, 'USD') AS currency_code,
  COALESCE(q.subtotal, 0) AS subtotal,
  COALESCE(q.discount_pct, 0) AS discount_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(q.subtotal, 0) * (COALESCE(q.discount_pct, 0) / 100.0), 2) AS discount_amount,
  COALESCE(q.total, 0) AS total,
  q.valid_until,
  q.sent_at,
  q.accepted_at,
  q.created_by_user_id,
  d.owner_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  q.approval_status,
  q.created_at,
  q.updated_at
FROM crm.quotes q
LEFT JOIN crm.deals d ON d.id = q.deal_id AND d.organization_id = q.organization_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = d.owner_user_id
WHERE q.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT COALESCE(ql.product_name, 'Other Products') AS product_name, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT q.deal_id) AS BIGINT) AS deal_count FROM rpt_quote_lines AS ql JOIN rpt_quotes AS q ON q.id = ql.quote_id WHERE q.deal_id IS NOT NULL AND TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE GROUP BY COALESCE(ql.product_name, 'Other Products') ORDER BY deal_count DESC LIMIT 500
